author: pescador de goiaba
title: Really good game
content:
Wow this game is just so awesome and I love the fact that we can upgrade stuff, like armour, helmet(or a crown), Swords and the ring. Best fighting game I’ve ever played, but also I wish there was like a little story that could tell us what happened to the game instead of just jumping into the campaign and start slaying monsters. 

Love the game but needs inprovement
